text:
I got x-rays, teeth cleaning and a check up here and was very happy with the results so I booked an appointment to return and take care of some other dental issues.

So I returned and the dentist painlessly fixed all outstanding issues.

Very happy with the professionalism of the dentist and his staff.

I went in to get crown on my front tooth and had an amazing experience at Smile Dental Clinic! Dr. Raviporn Madarasmi did a really great job on giving me recommendations and communicating with me and at the end she did a really good job and I am so happy with the results. I highly recommend!! 😀 …

I tried to get an x-ray, the nurse are really unprofessional, when they put the back cover forthe X-ray photo taking, it almost choked me to death. The price for 1 small slide is 250baht, which I thought it was ok, but then they charge another 100 baht for "sterile fee" kidding me?? Also the X-ray wasn't exactly good. (Token by those unprofessional nurse)

Tried to make an appt. for today but was told the dentist is finishing up with 2 patients & then he’s leaving for the day (it’s now 20 min. To 1pm). Hours for today (Sun.) is supposed to be till 7pm! Well then, have a great Sunday Doc.! 🙄🙄 …

The assistant was talkative and not pay the attention sometimes put the equipment into my mouth quite hard also i went to do the two tooth filling and scaling a doctor said will be quick doesn’t need Anesthetics Oral, i put the hand up in the middle many times it was pain ,
Treatment was quick and painless, plus cheap. Doctor speaks good english.

What started as slight tooth sensitivity turned into much worse sensitivity and spread to other teeth.
Plus, I lost the strength to chew.
I had to submit the social security claim myself.
I had to claim the insurance myself.
I even submitted the claim for cheaper treatment elsewhere.
Instead of getting enough reimbursement from insurance, I ended up paying double, and my teeth are even worse than before.

Finally, they recommended dental implants and crowns.
My life...

The nurse was very helpful and provided excellent information.
The doctor was polite and very caring, and spoke English as well.
I was so scared during my dental treatment that my hands were shaking. The nurse gave me a cloth to hold onto, and sometimes even held my hand to calm me down.🤣
It was a little embarrassing, but with such great care, you can have my credit card! 10 out of 10, no deductions!

Today I came for tartar removal. The dentist was very thorough, cleaning every nook and cranny. They provided excellent advice and recommendations on aftercare. The assistant was lovely, and all the reception staff were kind and polite. I will definitely be back for more services.
The service was good. The doctor was gentle, and the staff were friendly.
